_about: Links from Symbolic World to Wikidata, v3.0.0 item 1. A link is here when the proposer (Opus family) chose it from a public Wikidata search and a checker from another family (Fable) accepted it, or when the two models disagreed and Damian decided; a link he decided carries a decision record. no_link records the disagreements he settled with no link. Candidates from tools/linking/wikidata_candidates.py; Damian spot-checks a seeded sample before release; spot_check records whether he has. Figure links name a node; author and text links name a source string of seed.json and are exported to the RDF only.
